scope: Fresh closed-loop rolling-reference experiment. Primary C versus N across three phases; A is a fixed secondary comparator. No parameter tuning or automatic adoption.

clock.moving_interval: Half-open [3,35); physical-state windows otherwise include the actual terminal state.
clock.command_interval: Every command except the final emitted but unheld command is held to the next physical state. Include actual prior input in command-step metrics.

settling.primary: All four conditions hold simultaneously at every actual-state sample in final [43,45] s; all three C phases must pass. Report first fully observed sustained2s entry and subsequent exits separately.

nontrivial_native_failure.comparison: At least one N phase fails settling and its final2s maximum strictly exceeds at least one listed threshold; no marginal threshold-crossing benefit claim.

reference_exposure.condition: Norm of selected-native jointvref[6:9] OR rollingFF[3:5] OR rollingFF[:3] reaches its threshold, on held moving intervals. Count only actual rolling-boundary intervention records.
reference_exposure.limitation: Reference-boundary exposure only; not a complete native-command counterfactual or proof the change survives preparation/clipping. Report actual preparation and clipping separately.

per_phase_C_vs_N_nonregression.geometric_cross_track: Descriptive only; no new S-specific turn/geometry gate.

hard_contracts: N/C complete registered45s physics with finite physical-state and held-input histories, no declared physical failure, applied caps respected and applied=clip(requested).
Same-phase N/A/C initial physical q/v and actual prior input equal exactly; no phase or observer reset after launch.
All cases use identical exact raw world XY/V/A reference clocks and fixed world goal; no per-arm reanchor.

Same-current-state invariance flags confirm unchanged observer update count, native normal/load routing, gain/support torque, body/attitude/XY references and preparation algorithm. Across diverged trajectories those quantities need not have equal values.
diagnostic_only: Geometric path distance from shared raw moving-reference polyline, distinct from timedtracking.
Full10s goalhold position/speed/yaw/referencelean distributions, first sustained2s entry and later exit.
Absolute platform tilt, transverse body angular speed/upvector rate, actual preparation blend and deltas.
Held command steps normalized by actual caps, requested clipping fractions; requested commands need not lie inside caps.
Sampled actual support events and estimator proposals do not form primary label-accuracy gates.
status_precedence: INVALID_SETUP for schema/source/reference/initial-condition/invariance violations; retain execution completion and cause separately.
FAIL_CONTROL_SCREEN if any primary C settling, physical or per-phase nonregression check fails.
INCONCLUSIVE if C otherwise passes but any C phase has insufficient reference-boundary exposure or no N phase has the declared nontrivial settling failure.
PASS_CONTROL_SCREEN only if all primary checks, exposure and nontrivial N failure hold. This does not adopt C or erase I72's failed estimator gates. A cannot replace C after outcomes.
